organSystems.name: Central Nervous & Neuro-Behavioral
organSystems.clinicalFunction: Cognitive processing, alertness, motor coordination, mood stability, and sleep-wake circadian regulation.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Sensory deprivation, elevated cabin CO2, and cosmic ray micro-lesions impair cognitive vigilance and increase sleep latency.
organSystems.source: NASA HRP BHP Element: Risk of Cognitive Impairment & Depression

organSystems.name: Ocular & Optic Nerve (SANS)
organSystems.clinicalFunction: Visual acuity, intraocular pressure regulation, and optic disc microcirculation.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Cephalad fluid shift causes optic disc edema, globe flattening, choroidal folds, and hyperopic refractive shifts (SANS).
organSystems.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1; Lee et al., Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), JAMA Ophthalmol 2020

organSystems.name: Cardiovascular & Hemodynamic
organSystems.clinicalFunction: Cardiac output, arterial perfusion, baroreflex regulation, and stroke volume adaptation.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Loss of hydrostatic pressure gradient leads to reduction in left ventricular mass (~8-10%) and orthostatic intolerance upon re-gravity.
organSystems.source: NASA HRP Human Physiology Countermeasures: Cardiovascular Risk Profile; Hughson et al., Heart in Space 2018

organSystems.name: Respiratory & Gas Exchange
organSystems.clinicalFunction: Alveolar gas diffusion, arterial oxygen saturation, and acid-base blood homeostasis.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Absence of gravity-driven ventilation/perfusion mismatch, but elevated cabin CO2 causes mild chronic hypercapnia and breathing fatigue.
organSystems.source: West JB., Respiratory system under spaceflight conditions, J Appl Physiol 2000; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2

organSystems.name: Metabolic & Gastrointestinal
organSystems.clinicalFunction: Nutrient absorption, glycemic control, gut microbiome homeostasis, and metabolic rate regulation.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Microgravity reduces gastrointestinal motility, alters microbiome diversity toward pro-inflammatory clades, and causes insulin resistance.
organSystems.source: NASA Twins Study: Science 2019; Garrett-Bakelman et al., Microbiome and Metabolic Shifts in Space

organSystems.name: Musculoskeletal & Bone Architecture
organSystems.clinicalFunction: Structural bone density (trabecular and cortical), postural muscle tone, and joint biomechanics.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Absence of skeletal loading induces osteoclast activation with ~1.0-1.5% bone density loss per month in calcaneus and spine, plus postural muscle atrophy.
organSystems.source: NASA HRP Bone Demineralization Risk Standard; Sibonga JD., Astronaut Bone Loss and ARED Countermeasures

organSystems.name: Immune & Hematopoietic System
organSystems.clinicalFunction: T-cell activation, viral latency containment, leukocyte production, and radioprotection.
organSystems.spaceflightImpact: Cosmic radiation coupled with psychological stress leads to T-cell dysfunction, latent virus reactivation (EBV, VZV), and early space anemia.
organSystems.source: Crucian B. et al., Immune System Dysregulation During Spaceflight, Frontiers in Immunology 2018
